rules: semantic selection is separate from coordinate placement
exact D1-D8 semantic duplicates are excluded
human-name equality alone does not prove semantic duplication
unplaced selected candidates consume semantic-inventory capacity but no coordinate authority
D9 remains unratified until explicit owner decision
